newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Daehan Flour to seek 22,000T U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Daehan Flour to seek 22,000T U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Daehan Flour Mills Co Ltd said on Tuesday it would invite tenders to buy another 22,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat by 2:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Wednesday.

A Daehan official said the 22,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat would be split into four lots -- 6,500 tonnes of western white/soft white (ordinary), 1,000 tonnes of western white/soft white (protein minimum 10.0 percent), 7,800 tonnes of hard red winter wheat (protein minimum 11.5 percent), and 6,700 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat (protein minimum 14 percent).
Shipment was set for September 20-October 20 to the western port of Inchon.
The company had bought 21,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat from Mitsubishi Corp early Tuesday for shipment between September 5-October 5.
